protocol.description: Protocol to use for connecting to the CardDAV server (http or https). Prefer https.

server_host.description: Hostname (fully qualified domain name) of the CardDAV server (e.g., cards.example.com).

port.description: TCP port the CardDAV server listens on (typically 443 for HTTPS, 80 for HTTP).

path.description: Base path on the server where CardDAV endpoints reside (e.g., /dav/, /carddav/). Set to '/' if root-based.

username.description: Username or email used to authenticate with the CardDAV server. Not stored in config in secure deployments.

password.description: Password for authentication. For security, consider leaving blank and using secure storage (e.g., secret-service).

display_name.description: User-friendly name for this account (e.g., 'Work Contacts' or 'Personal CardDAV').

principal_url.description: Explicit WebDAV principal URL (e.g., /principals/user@example.com/). Leave blank for autodiscovery.

enable_sync.description: Enable background sync of contacts (if supported by the plugin and backend).

verify_ssl.description: Verify the server’s SSL/TLS certificate. Disable only for testing with self-signed certs (not recommended).

address_book_path.description: Explicit path to the user’s address book collection (e.g., /user/me/cards/). Omit to rely on autodiscovery.

headers.description: List of custom HTTP headers to send with each request (format: 'Header-Name: Value').

items.description: A single HTTP header in 'Name: Value' format (e.g., 'X-Custom-Client: lomiri')

force_http1.description: Force use of HTTP/1.1 instead of HTTP/2. Enable only if the server has HTTP/2 issues.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for transient network failures.
